review_policy: Re-check primary sources when their review_after date or a relevant Codex/tool release is reached.

practices.local_problem: Keep two skills discoverable without loading the full preference catalog into every turn.
practices.decision: Use concise entrypoints, progressive disclosure, direct resource links, and a plugin bundle.
practices.adaptation: Flow explicitly loads the preference skill; the preference registry routes targeted details.
practices.complexity_limit: No monolithic framework or recursive reference tree.
practices.evaluation: Validate frontmatter, direct references, openai.yaml prompts, and contract cases.

practices.local_problem: Bound concurrency, isolate review roles, and prevent delegation drift.
practices.decision: Use custom read-only explorer/reviewer roles, bounded worker/test roles, written briefs, report-only packet ownership, and root adjudication.
practices.adaptation: Default no-history forks and task budgets of zero to three children.
practices.complexity_limit: One child level by default; no automatic delegation.
practices.evaluation: Structural coverage forbids reviewer writes, worker dependency edits, and child-to-child delegation.

practices.local_problem: Make documentation/dependency/agent gates harder to forget.
practices.decision: Bundle conservative PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SubagentStart/Stop, and Stop hooks scoped to an active packet.
practices.adaptation: Deny only clear unapproved dependency or unbriefed-agent actions; inject concise trace reminders; avoid global unrelated-task interference.
practices.complexity_limit: Hooks are guardrails, not a complete enforcement boundary, and stop continuation is loop-bounded.
practices.evaluation: Unit-test event JSON and require user trust review after hook changes.

practices.local_problem: Detect workflow regressions beyond Markdown syntax.
practices.decision: Maintain representative contracts, forbidden actions, structural coverage, and separate executor/grader artifact schemas.
practices.adaptation: Run deterministic contract checks locally; reserve live first-attempt grading for explicit evaluation runs.
practices.complexity_limit: Do not require paid live evals for normal skill validation.
practices.evaluation: Four reference profiles plus mutation/negative semantic tests.

practices.local_problem: Requirements, design, tasks, and evidence can drift apart.
practices.decision: Use stable AC/SC/VO IDs and semantic cross-artifact validation.
practices.adaptation: One lightweight packet rather than a separate command-heavy framework.
practices.complexity_limit: No mandatory constitution generation per project.
practices.evaluation: Reject missing or mismatched ID mappings.

practices.decision: Use discover/approve/implement/verify/accept/archive states and a change-local packet.
practices.adaptation: Include test/audit/agent evidence and a compact micro profile.
practices.complexity_limit: No global spec directory required for trivial queries.

practices.local_problem: Preserve debugging discipline and review repair quality without heavyweight mandatory ceremony.
practices.decision: Adopt causal debugging, bounded written tasks, fresh verification, same-implementer repair, and scoped re-review.
practices.adaptation: Use risk-scaled packets/agents/tests instead of mandatory TDD, worktrees, and double review for every task.
practices.complexity_limit: No automatic worktree or subagent requirement.
practices.evaluation: Bug-fix contracts and three-attempt breaker mutations.

practices.local_problem: Security evidence, provenance, dependency governance, and release closure need lifecycle coverage.
practices.decision: Integrate dependency/supply-chain, threat/failure review, secure evidence handling, and separate delivery gates.
practices.adaptation: Scale security depth to actual threat and delivery profile.
practices.complexity_limit: Do not require enterprise compliance artifacts for low-risk local changes.

practices.local_problem: Agents can drift, overreach authority, leak context, or trust each other's claims.
practices.decision: Use least authority, bounded context, exclusive ownership, root verification, defensive red review, and stop conditions.
practices.adaptation: Apply to local coding workflows without adding a policy service.
practices.complexity_limit: No dependency on a remote agent-security platform.
practices.evaluation: Forbidden action and structural delegation edges.

practices.local_problem: Browser compatibility tests need explicit projects, isolation, retry, and trace evidence.
practices.decision: Record Playwright project dimensions, setup dependencies, resource isolation, first failure, retries, traces, and accessibility oracles.
practices.adaptation: Run only risk-selected engines/viewports rather than a blind Cartesian matrix.
practices.complexity_limit: No always-on full browser matrix for micro changes.

practices.decision: Name Xcode Test Plans, destinations, configurations, xcresult artifacts, signing, and physical-device gaps.
practices.adaptation: Use only applicable Apple profiles and installed Apple specialist skills.
practices.complexity_limit: Do not claim device behavior from simulator-only results.

practices.local_problem: Emulator fleets and JNI evidence need reproducible ownership and artifacts.
practices.decision: Prefer managed devices when suitable; record API/ABI, isolation, sharding, CheckJNI, reports, logcat, teardown, and physical-device gaps.
practices.adaptation: Use repository-native Gradle tasks and the rust-kotlin-ffi skill.
practices.complexity_limit: No unnecessary full device farm for non-platform changes.

practices.local_problem: Quality and speed tradeoffs need outcome evidence rather than ceremony counts.
practices.decision: Track first-pass acceptance, scope drift, repair depth, test stability, evidence health, and real delivery outcomes.
practices.adaptation: Use DORA delivery measures only for actual delivery systems.
practices.complexity_limit: Do not score a local edit as deployment performance.
